sources.snippet: This is test-set model selection, so the reported values are an upper bound rather than an unbiased estimate. Retraining from the base model will not reproduce these numbers exactly: fp16 training is nondeterministic and epoch-selection margins are small, so a rerun lands on a different epoch and a slightly different score.
